test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "flexibility."**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In this context, **"flexibility"** implies that states have the freedom or adaptability to make decisions and choices regarding the operation of their universities, schools, and education syllabus. (राज्यों को अपने विश्वविद्यालयों, स्कूलों और शिक्षा पाठ्यक्रम के संचालन के संबंध में निर्णय लेने और विकल्प चुनने की स्वतंत्रता या अनुकूलनशीलता है)
 
• It suggests that there is room for variation and adjustment in how each state manages its educational institutions and curriculum, allowing for a certain degree of autonomy.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

 ​

Correct paragraph: 

The challenge in Madras high court to the Emergency-era shifting of education from state list to concurrent list is__ a futile exercise in turning back the clock. Forty-six years have passed __since__ the 42 Constitution Amendment Act. In this period, the education sector has seen far too many changes, and most can’t be __reversed__. For instance, a common national medical test now allows students the ease of appearing for just one examination instead of multiple ones conducted by each state. States still enjoy __**flexibility**__ to operate their own universities, schools and education syllabus..........

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Flexible: **able to bend or move easily without breaking. (लचीला, लचकदार)
 
• **Suitable: **right or appropriate for somebody/something. ((किसी के लिए) सही या उचित या उपयुक्त)
 
• **Suitability: **the state or quality of being satisfactory or in accord with what is desired or called for. (जो वांछित या अपेक्षित है उसके अनुरूप या संतोषजनक होने की अवस्था या गुण)
